## Result

Describe the change and its exact scope. For research, identify the claim as a
bound, conditional result, finite certificate, obstruction, or partial result.

## Sources and cost

Identify the predecessor, source revision, assumptions, changed mechanism, and
relevant cost accounting. For other changes, describe the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Distinguish finite checks, formal
lemmas, complete proofs, and independent review; list unrun checks.

## Remaining work and credit

State open obligations and the next question. Retain source and contributor
credit and disclose substantial AI assistance.

The main README must stay current. If this change affects a result, evidence,
verification, or an open obligation, update its status, links, and reproduction
instructions in this change. Link the coordination-board handoff when relevant.
